sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste. -- leveling 'Ability Haste' values = [10, 20, 30]; active cooldown values = [120, 100, 80]; castTime = 0.25
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
modeled: ["P", "Q", "Q2", "W", "E", "R"] ... modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge) ... splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). With `c_i` the effective cooldown of ability `i`, the cast epochs of a solo ability are `0, c_i, 2c_i, ...` -- again a deterministic renewal schedule; the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
Ability haste (`effective_cooldown`) | `cd' = cd*100/(100+AH)`; casts/unit time affine in AH | EXACT | R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)

why_index_7_is_Q_robustly.claim: With the 2-charge opener, order[0..4] is the five-cast t=0 block and order[5..7] are the first three recast epochs, which are always Q, W, Q.
why_index_7_is_Q_robustly.proof: With H_R = 30 (R rank 3) and any item ability haste AH >= 0: c_Q = 700/(130+AH), c_W = 800/(100+AH), c_E = 1500/(100+AH). (i) c_Q < c_W  <=>  700(100+AH) < 800(130+AH), true for all AH >= 0. (ii) c_W < 2c_Q  <=>  800(130+AH) < 1400(100+AH)  <=>  104000+800AH < 140000+1400AH, true for all AH >= 0. (iii) 2c_Q < c_E  <=>  1400(100+AH) < 1500(130+AH), true for all AH >= 0. Hence the recast order is c_Q (Q), c_W (W), 2c_Q (Q) before E ever recasts, so order[7] = Q.
why_index_7_is_Q_robustly.numeric_invariance_check: Simulated for AH = 0,5,...,200: order[7] = 'Q' in every case; simulated over all 120 permutations of the t=0 custom opener {Q, Q(2nd charge), W, E, R}: order[7] = 'Q' in every case.
why_index_7_is_Q_robustly.insensitivity_to_the_R_passive_reading: If the engine instead ignores R's Dark-Sphere haste (Q cooldown flat 7 s, matching the JSON's cooldown.affectedByCdr = false) the sequence becomes Q,Q,W,E,R, Q@7, W@8, Q@14 -> order[7] = Q as well.

independent_computation.conclusion: Under either reading of Q's haste, and under any custom opener permutation, the eighth cast of Syndra's shared-timeline rotation at >= 40 Splinters of Wrath is a Dark Sphere. The only mechanism in the cached wiki text that lengthens Syndra's rotation by one cast is the Q Transcendent bonus (2 charges at 40+ splinters), which the scenario's 60 splinters satisfies; without it exactly 7 casts fit the window, which is precisely the old <absent>.

caveats: The scenario's exact fight window, item build and rank assignment were not readable from the permitted evidence tree (they live in scripts/, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids). The computation above is therefore stated as an invariant: for any fight window whose last cast is the eighth (i.e. ending in (10.769 s, 15.000 s] at AH 0), any ability haste, and any custom opener permutation, order[7] = Q.

One inconsistent corner would give E instead: Q's cooldown treated as flat 7 s (affectedByCdr = false) *while* the build carries >= ~15 item ability haste, which shrinks W below Q. That reading contradicts R's own passive ('Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste'), and an order-only scenario carries no items.

If the 60 in the scenario name were a 60-second fight duration rather than 60 splinters, the rotation would contain ~22 casts and order[7] could not have been <absent> in the old baseline -- so the splinters reading is the only one consistent with the reported old value.
